# Unit-test the OpenGymState logic without homeassistant installed.
import sys, types, json, importlib.util
from datetime import date, timedelta

# Stub package + homeassistant imports used by coordinator
pkg = types.ModuleType("og"); pkg.__path__=["custom_components/opengym"]
sys.modules["og"] = pkg
const = types.ModuleType("og.const")
for k, v in {"DOMAIN":"opengym","MUSCLES":{"chest":"Chest","deltoids":"Shoulders","abs":"Core","hamstring":"Hamstrings"},"RECOVERY_DAYS":2,"SCAN_INTERVAL":None,"DEFAULT_POLL_INTERVAL":15}.items():
    setattr(const,k,v)
sys.modules["og.const"]=const
# stub homeassistant modules
for name in ["homeassistant","homeassistant.core","homeassistant.helpers","homeassistant.helpers.update_coordinator","homeassistant.helpers.aiohttp_client","aiohttp"]:
    m = types.ModuleType(name); sys.modules[name]=m
class DUCE:  # DataUpdateCoordinator stub
    def __init__(self,*a,**k): pass
sys.modules["homeassistant.helpers.update_coordinator"].DataUpdateCoordinator = DUCE
sys.modules["homeassistant.helpers.update_coordinator"].UpdateFailed = Exception
sys.modules["homeassistant.core"].HomeAssistant = object
sys.modules["homeassistant.core"].callback = lambda f: f
api = types.ModuleType("og.api"); api.OpenGymApiClient=object; api.OpenGymError=Exception; api.OpenGymConnectionError=Exception
sys.modules["og.api"]=api

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("og.coordinator","custom_components/opengym/coordinator.py")
co = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(co)

today = date(2026,11,13)
state = {
  "unit":"kg",
  "week":{1:"r-push",3:"r-legs"},  # So=1 push, Di? we use Sun=0..Sat=6; 1=Mon push, 3=Wed legs
  "routines":[{"id":"r-push","name":"Push","ex":[1,2]},{"id":"r-legs","name":"Legs","ex":[3]}],
  "workouts":[
    {"id":"w1","d":"2026-11-09","name":"Push","vol":4200,"prs":["0025"],"entries":[{"id":"1254","sets":[{"w":80,"r":5}]}]},
    {"id":"w2","d":"2026-11-11","name":"Legs","vol":6100,"entries":[{"id":"1010","sets":[{"w":100,"r":8}]}]},
  ],
  "bodyweight":[{"d":"2026-11-01","w":81.2},{"d":"2026-11-12","w":80.4}],
}
s = co.OpenGymState(state)
assert s.unit=="kg"
assert s.last_workout()["id"]=="w2"
assert s.last_weighin()["w"]==80.4
monday = today - timedelta(days=today.weekday())  # Mon Nov 9
assert s.week_count(today)==2, s.week_count(today)
assert abs(s.week_volume(today)-10300)<1
assert s.streak(today)==0
assert s.streak(date(2026,11,11))==1
# Nov 11 (Wed) plan: legs
r = s.routine_for(date(2026,11,11)); assert r and r["name"]=="Legs", r
# Nov 9 (Mon) push
r = s.routine_for(date(2026,11,9)); assert r and r["name"]=="Push", r
# Nov 13 (Fri) rest
assert s.routine_for(today) is None
nxt = s.next_session(today)  # Mon Nov 16 push
assert nxt and nxt[1]==date(2026,11,16) and nxt[0]["name"]=="Push", nxt
md = s.muscle_days(today)
assert md["chest"]==4, md  # trained Nov 9
assert md["hamstring"]==2, md
assert md["abs"]==999
print("COORDINATOR_TESTS_OK", md)
EOF
